findings.reason: correcting the named file in one sentence repairs the record without altering any code change the design requires, and the real readers are already listed.
findings.text: the §25 migration list names `imas_codex/llm/server.py` among the readers of CodeFile's retired triage fields, but server.py reads only `FacilityPath.triage_composite`; the actual CodeFile triage-field readers are `imas_codex/discovery/code/parallel.py:411,423,449`, `imas_codex/discovery/code/graph_ops.py:414,528,703`, `imas_codex/discovery/code/workers.py:329,577,1049`, `imas_codex/discovery/code/progress.py:742,830`, `imas_codex/discovery/code/scorer.py:121,354,414` and `imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py:_CODE_TRIAGE_FIELDS` (lines 339-351), so the stale entry sends a node to edit a file that needs no change

findings.reason: the plan must state the ordering or the per-run override that lets §14's code run reach its low-scoring trees once the code-file gate moves to `code-ingest-threshold`, otherwise the §14 done-when (chunks under three trees, `JLOOP`/`JTPRB`/`JNPRB` found) is unreachable after §25.
findings.text: §25 retires code's reading of `--min-score` ("`--min-score` keeps only its path-scan meaning, and ingest no longer reads it"), but `discover code`'s `min_score` is precisely the code-file ingest gate today (imas_codex/discovery/code/parallel.py:449 pending-ingest count and :493 pending-embed count, and imas_codex/discovery/code/workers.py:578 ingest claim), which is why §14's pending scoped code run passes `--min-score 0` and states "the threshold has nothing left to protect here"; the section neither names that §14's run depends on the option's code-file meaning nor says whether the run must precede §25, so after §25 lands the same command gates the SAeqread/client_eqdbms/getseldata_v4.2 files at `code-ingest-threshold` 0.5 instead of 0

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — `call_decisions()`/`acall_decisions()` hide request build, the retry loop, answer validation (noul lies in [0,1], choice membership, probability sum) and cost extraction behind one call, and §14's `build_path_prefix_filter` returns clause and bound parameters together so the nine code claims cannot detach a clause from its binding; both are interfaces smaller than the behaviour behind them.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §25's reader census for the retired CodeFile triage fields lists `imas_codex/llm/server.py`, which reads only the path-triage field (`FacilityPath.triage_composite` at imas_codex/llm/server.py:2326,2348,2351), not any CodeFile field.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §25 carries an explicit Interface account that names what it retires (eleven CodeFile triage fields, the LLM rubric in code/triage.md, code's use of `get_triage_threshold`, ingest's reading of `--min-score`) against what it adds, and §14 adds no CLI, MCP or refusal surface (it retires `seed_missing_roots` and `create_child_paths`); the retirements account for the additions.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the design sections that remain unbuilt cite the machinery they extend, and opening the code confirms each: §25 reuses `_is_retryable` (imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:1188), `DEFAULT_RETRY_BASE_DELAY` (:694), `get_api_key_for_service` (:910), `_build_kwargs` (:1995), `get_model`/`MODEL_SECTIONS`/`_MODEL_ENV_VARS` (imas_codex/settings.py:141,212,235), `render_prompt`, and the shared `facility.data_access_patterns` source; §14's residue uses the owners `render_path_prefix_clause` (imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py:268), `build_path_prefix_filter` (:282), `reset_to_status` (imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py:66) and `GraphClient.create_nodes` (imas_codex/graph/client.py:605).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §25 states why the existing machinery cannot carry the decisions call: `call_llm_structured` (imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:2203) sends chat completions with a response schema in the prompt, whereas the decisions endpoint takes `{model, state, questions}` and returns a different shape, so the plan extracts `_service_headers` from `_build_kwargs` (:2152) rather than forking header construction.
